description_en: Retrieves a list of artifacts from a specified session
description_zh: 查询指定会话产出的Artifact文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-agent-session-artifacts --jsonrpc 2.0 --id 10001 --params RequestId=req_20260421_001 NextToken=CAESExFsbyH... MaxResults=20 SessionId=sess_0f12abc34 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentSessionArtifacts

parameters.help_en: The ID passed by the caller. The value is returned as-is in the response
parameters.help_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The session ID. If this parameter is not specified, an error `sessionCode` is required is returned
fields.help_zh: 会话 ID，缺失报错 `sessionCode` is required
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The request code used to filter artifacts. If specified, only artifacts generated by the specified request are returned
fields.help_zh: 按单次请求 code 过滤，仅看该请求产出的 artifact
fields.name: request_id

fields.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 50
fields.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The continuation token for retrieving the next page of results. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
fields.help_zh: OSS 下一页 continuation token，首页不传
fields.name: next_token
